task_name: World 135 Task A  -  Consolidated 2150 Corporate Card Hierarchy Tie-Out, Post-Cutoff Feed Exclusion, Deleted Charge Restoration & Null-Statement Proxy Hold
prompt: Review the QuickBooks Online chart of accounts, statement and portal custody table, Amex corporate card bank-feed stream (synced through November 4, 2026), posted October 2026 QuickBooks Online general ledger, and audit log for Summit Mechanical & HVAC Corp. in summit_hvac_oct2026_bank_feed_proxy_and_card_parent_gl.xlsx. Reconcile the consolidated October 31, 2026 liability for 2150 Corporate Card Master (including standalone parent-account postings and child subaccounts 2151 and 2152), back out post-cutoff November 1 - 4 settled card feed charges, reverse any duplicate card autopayment postings, restore any deleted mid-month reconciled October card charges, and determine whether 2150 can be certified as statement-reconciled or must be held under a bank-feed proxy hold.

rubric.description: Computes the implied October 31, 2026 Amex corporate card bank-feed proxy liability as $29,680.00 by backing out $3,490.00 of post-cutoff November 1 - 4 settled feed charges ($2,850.00 FEED-AMEX-N1 on 2026-11-02 and $640.00 FEED-AMEX-N2 on 2026-11-03) from the November 4, 2026 live running feed balance of $33,170.00.

Includes standalone parent-account postings directly on 2150 Corporate Card Master (-$1,200.00 CC-2150-REB Carrier rebate credit and +$550.00 CC-2150-FEE annual fee, net -$650.00 before payments) alongside child subaccounts 2151 and 2152, avoiding the $30,330.00 leaf-minus-payment error that omits standalone parent activity.

Identifies that the October 20, 2026 $25,000.00 Amex autopayment (FEED-1010-05 / FEED-AMEX-06) was posted twice in QuickBooks Online via CCP-408 and EXP-912 (-$50,000.00 combined debit), requiring reversal of EXP-912 via Dr 1010 Operating Checking $25,000.00 / Cr 2150 Corporate Card Master $25,000.00.

Identifies from AUD-4409 and FEED-AMEX-01 that cleared October 3, 2026 Trane Commercial Supply charge TXN-8841 ($2,340.00 on 2151) was deleted on October 22, 2026, requiring restoration via Dr 5120 HVAC Parts & Refrigerant COGS $2,340.00 / Cr 2151 Card - Field Lead #9014 $2,340.00.

Reconciles unadjusted October 31, 2026 card GL balances (-$50,650.00 standalone 2150 + $29,080.00 2151 + $23,910.00 2152 = $2,340.00 consolidated) to audited balances (-$25,650.00 standalone 2150 + $31,420.00 2151 + $23,910.00 2152 = $29,680.00 consolidated), tying 100.00% ($0.00 variance) to the $29,680.00 October 31 bank-feed proxy.

Refuses to mark 2150 Corporate Card Master as statement_certified because statement_doc_id is NULL and no October 2026 PDF card statement is custodied, placing a named bank_feed_proxy_hold / preliminary_bank_feed_proxy disclosure pending statement retrieval.

Verifies October 2026 gross card charge subtotals by cardholder subaccount: $18,420.00 on 2151 (#9014: $2,340.00 restored TXN-8841 + $16,080.00 CC-2151-01) and $14,910.00 on 2152 (#9022: $9,400.00 CC-2152-01 + $3,110.00 CC-2152-02 + $2,400.00 CC-2152-03), on top of the $22,000.00 combined October 1 opening liability ($13,000.00 + $9,000.00).

Confirms post-cutoff November 2 - 3 feed charges FEED-AMEX-N1 ($2,850.00) and FEED-AMEX-N2 ($640.00) represent November 2026 purchases and must not be accrued into October 2026 COGS or expenses ($0.00 October accrual).
